run.label: onboarding-v2-hand
run.note: Onboarding v2 (PR #624) hand checks on test.gokesari.com 03fc4a01, 26-Nov-2026 21.26–22.09 IST

results.title: Shop identity step: Terms tick with version, links, e-mail, mobile SMS code
results.detail: gk-shop /shop/register?new=1 (21.26 IST): v2 identity card shown; Terms text shows 'version 2026-11-26'; Accept → ✓ Accepted; e-mail already verified; 'Send me a code by SMS' to +91 …0102 → code read from the mock outbox (Admin → Test messages) → Confirm → step 2 (referral). FAIL: the Terms & Conditions / Privacy Policy links go to /terms and /privacy, both HTTP 404 (D-167). Screenshot test-results/ov2x/s1.png

results.title: Referral step: Request a referral code
results.detail: gk-shop draft step 2: 'Request a referral code' opens the request form (your name, mobile, type of shop list, address; location optional); not submitted. Then referral code entered → Continue → 'Verify your business' (GST / PAN). Screenshot test-results/ov2x/s3-request-code.png
results.partial: the request was not sent (it e-mails the team)

results.title: Paid franchise: zone, LAUNCH_1Y, coupon, sandbox payment → GKF code
results.detail: customer2 (staging dealer), 22.06–22.08 IST: /franchise/start → Choose zones and plan → GKZ-PUN-21 Pune – Hadapsar → plan '1-year launch offer ₹1,50,000 + GST per zone · 12 months', total ₹1,77,000 (GST ₹27,000); coupon QAOV2NOSUCH → 'Coupon QAOV2NOSUCH does not exist.'; 'Live as soon as you pay' (no 30-day KYC); Reserve and pay → Cashfree SANDBOX checkout (test merchant); paid with scripts/test-site/sandbox-pay.mjs netbanking-success (Order Pay 200, simulator SUCCESS) → isFranchisee true, roles franchisee_paid; /franchise/my: zone Active, valid until 25-Nov-2027 23.59 IST, code GKF-Q6MRP2. The checkout's own simulator page stayed on 'Loading…' in local Chromium, hence the script.
results.partial: a valid coupon was not applied (none exists on staging; admin data not created)
results.test: hand: paid franchise with sandbox payment

results.title: Login sheet step 3: mobile SMS code (mock) verifies the number; account DONE with wallet
results.detail: Automated 21.33 IST (ops: CODE_SENT +91 ******0108, wrong code 422, right code → DONE, mobile verified, wallet 200). Again 22.15 IST for the customer account (gk-lc14), whose mobile a regression profile check had left unverified: POST /api/onboarding-v2/customer/mobile send → CODE_SENT; code from Admin → Test messages (SMS mock); verify → 200, step DONE, mobile verified. The automated check is 'blocked' on later runs only because no staging account is left at the MOBILE step.
